insight.headline: currententrychange now returns the previous page in event.from for customer account full-page extensions
insight.what_changed: Starting in API version 2027-01, in customer account full-page extensions the Navigation API currententrychange event sets event.from to the page the customer navigated away from, instead of the page they navigated to. This is a breaking change for customer account full-page extensions that read the new page from event.from. Update them to read shopify.navigation.currentEntry before you move them…
